issues.what: The segment-bootstrap tape is called a 'memory-free null' alongside GMM-Markov, but a 30-bar block is 2.5 hours on the 5-minute tape and retains most of the SETUP's own structure and outcome path; attributions of 'engine mechanics, not market memory' are clean only for the GMM tapes. Conservative for the pass rule (a candidate must beat both p95s), so no false-pass risk, but the label overstates.
issues.where: OUT/studies/null_tapes_drift/FINDINGS.md lines 10 ('the two memory-free nulls (GMM-Markov and segment)'), 84, 226; gen_tapes.py lines 11-13
issues.evidence: Recomputed on the real IS L1 units: 5minute bars_since_choch p50 2 (98.9% <= 30 bars), bars_since_bos p50 9 (87.3% <= 30), 53.5% of L1 trades have their whole SETUP->exit path inside a clock-aligned 30-bar block (79.3% exit within 30 bars); minute: 99.8% / 88.4% / 43.3%. Reality table confirms the segment tape matches real |r| autocorr at lags 1-5 (0.22 vs 0.234) where GMM dies by lag 3.
issues.fix: In FINDINGS section 1/4b/7 call the segment tape 'short-memory null (<= 30 bars = 2.5 h on 5 min, 30 min on 1 min)' and rest the 'not market memory' reading on the GMM tapes; keep the pass rule as is (it is the stricter of the two).

issues.what: The pass-rule component 'session-bootstrap diffs carry the real sign in >= 75% of tapes' is presented as pre-registered (DESIGN_PANEL (c) + Judge 1) but does not appear in DESIGN_PANEL.md or BRIEF.md; it is the study's own addition. It is an extra requirement (stricter), so it cannot produce a false pass.
issues.where: FINDINGS.md line 226; tapes.py docstring lines 19-23 ('at least 15 of 20 tapes'); run_tapes.py lines 89-93 (how_to_compare)
issues.evidence: grep of fz_v3/*.md for '75%', '15 of 20', 'same sign', 'stability read' matches only the study's own files; DESIGN_PANEL.md line 376 says only 'report the kept-vs-skipped difference on (i) (stability)' and the go/no-go 'real-tape difference above the null-tape 95th percentile'.
issues.fix: Label the 75% session-bootstrap sign criterion as the study's fixed choice (not pre-registered) in FINDINGS section 7 and findings.json.how_to_evaluate_candidate.

issues.what: Caveat on INR scaling with the tape's price level is stated in one direction ('a high-level tape widens the null in INR ... conservative') but the 1-minute tapes sit BELOW the real average level, so their INR null is narrower (anti-conservative by ~13-16%); the caveat also omits that the minute null is built from 1-year tapes (~1,000-1,400 units) while the real minute statistic uses 4,452 units, which is the main reason it is wider (~2x sd), not the 8-tape count alone.
issues.evidence: Recomputed mean close over all bars: real IS 20,877; minute tapes p50 gmm 17,576 / segment 18,138 / session 18,230; 5minute tapes p50 21,949 / 21,560 / 22,400 (so the caveat holds for 5 min only). Units per minute tape p50 1,436 / 1,126 / 1,032 (null_distributions.json) vs real n 4,452 (ledger 249b8433a25f5b8a).
issues.fix: Split caveat 1 by timeframe (5 min: slightly higher level, conservative; 1 min: lower level, narrower INR null) and add the 1-year-vs-5-year sample-size mismatch to caveat 6 as the dominant, conservative source of width.

issues.what: The 'chance level' for the drift AUC is a row-wise label permutation; for a temporally contiguous label (11 of 12 blocks single-class) this is the exchangeable-rows null, which any long-memory feature beats, so 'well above chance' is correct but the formal null is weak. The substantive reading (level/volatility regime drift, AUC 0.95/0.97) does not depend on it, and the design asked only for AUC + SHAP.
issues.evidence: Recomputed: only block 5 contains both early and late rows (block sizes 5minute [82,83,42,76,72,73,77,51,76,80,31,83]); perm p95 0.5255/0.5239 reproduce from the stored perm_aucs (5minute p95 0.5417 vs reported 0.5418 is 4-dp rounding of the stored list).
issues.fix: State in section 6 that the permutation null is the exchangeable-rows chance level, not a block-preserving null, and read the AUC as a drift magnitude, not a p-value.

issues.what: The brief's per-study deliverable 'the family's PBO / SPA / effective trial count' is not stated for ledger family null_tapes_drift/real_ref (three pre-registered comparator gates per timeframe, no search). Acceptable since nothing was searched, but FINDINGS should say 'not applicable: no search, 3 fixed comparators' explicitly.
issues.evidence: H.read_ledger('null_tapes_drift') returns exactly 6 rows (3 gates x 2 tf), all with config.gate fixed in tapes.MECHANICAL_GATES; no other family written by the study.
issues.fix: Add one line to section 9: 'PBO / SPA / effective trials: not applicable (no search; 6 pre-registered comparator rows)'.
